content: Home care / on-demand marketplace failures (HomeHero, Homejoy, Respect, Portea). Root causes: unit economics + CAC > LTV; poor retention; disintermediation (best staff go direct with clients); quality control across distributed workers; market not open to self-serve (high-touch referral dominates); regulatory/labor classification surprises; building product ahead of validated demand; price-sensitive market; underestimating incumbent local agencies. Lessons: validate willingness to pay before building; build defensible supply; provide on-platform value (payments, scheduling, reviews) to prevent leakage; start narrow/geographic.
